newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM says it has Dairy Queen franchise.
newsitem.headline: RFM says it has Dairy Queen franchise.

text.p: RFM Corp was given the local ice cream franchise of America's Dairy Queen International when a unit purchased two bottling plants last year, senior RFM official B.J. Sebastian said on Friday.
Sebastian said the grant of the franchise was not disclosed at the time.

Another RFM unit, Selecta Dairy Products, rose sharply on the Manila bourse on Thursday on rumours that it had acquired the Dairy Queen franchise. But Sebastian said RFM planned to set up another subsidiary to operate the franchise.

Shares in Selecta Dairy Products, a unit of RFM, rose in late trading Friday on rumours it acquired the Dairy Queen franchise. The stock was last traded at 2.34 pesos, up 2.6 percent on Thursday's close of 2.28 pesos.
Sebastian said RFM would check whether the franchise transferred by the Syjuco family also included Hong Kong and Macau which was part of the original contract of the Syjuco family with Dairy Queen.
